definitions.delta: Immutable source full-supported-class centered F32 correction gathered into unique original native candidate slots; never retrained.
definitions.A: Existing P5 mask: both original branches retained, unequal classes/canonical slots, valid query T>1, actual support for both classes.
definitions.pair: Gather explicit branch V/F corrections; D=F32((F64(delta_F)-F64(delta_V))/2), then scatter [-D,+D].
definitions.cell01: A*pair(delta)+(1-A)*delta; identity extension outside the admissible pair domain, not an all-proposal projection
definitions.no_defined_pair: Same-class, single-branch, invalid-query and unsupported-pair cases retain delta in cell01 and zero it in gated cells. No absent candidate is created.
definitions.operator_identity: The gate and identity-extended projection commute. Outside A cell01==cell00 and cell11==cell10; on A cell01==cell11, cell10==cell00, at correction level.
definitions.statistics: All 4 simple effects and descriptive AP interaction11-10-01+00, every sign retained. No parameter selection on these outcomes.

pipeline.sigmoid: Dense CPU torch F32 sigmoid of saved formal T per-seed logits plus correction; correction0 copies original formal T per-seed quality bitwise.
pipeline.mix: Independent E3 visual-clean three-seed mean and corrected head geometric mix .5/.5 with clip1e-6..1, F64 thenF32
pipeline.router: Original formal Tavail selected branch fixed for every cell
pipeline.score: raw^.5 * quality^.5; original same-class Gaussian sigma1
pipeline.GT: Original positive unique annotation IDs, same full params/images/categories; no new matching in exporters.

reuse: 00 and11 must exactly reproduce same-alpha/same-route prior full and published pair prediction bytes, entire q and key score traces; then only exact prediction/GT/params/native library native metrics can be reused.
scope: Fixed-weight posthoc diagnostic after test exposure, not confirmation or an untouched-test evaluation. Zero-sum logit correction is not probability-mean invariance; Gaussian can indirectly change inactive final scores.
